title: More Powerful, Less Verifiable? Mitigating Hard-to-Verify Hallucinations in MLLM's Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.32055v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) strengthens model capabilities through feedback from humans and environments. However, emerging evidence suggests that reward optimization can produce outputs whose errors are harder for humans to detect. To address this issue, we construct ITHV (the Image-Text Hallucination Verifiability Dataset), comprising 2,728 visually grounded instances that distinguish between obvious hallucinations, which humans readily detect, and elusive hallucinations, which humans struggle to identify. We then propose DAPO-V, an extension of DAPO that maximizes correctness subject to a budget on verifiability-aware risk. Specifically, DAPO-V combines a verifiability-aware reward with adaptive dual control, where larger penalties are assigned to incorrect responses on questions with lower human verification accuracy. translated_title: 更强却更难验证？缓解多模态大语言模型强化学习中难以验证的幻觉
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.32055v1 公告类型：新 摘要：强化学习（RL）通过来自人类和环境的反馈来增强模型能力。然而，新的证据表明，奖励优化可能产生错误更难被人类察觉的输出。为解决这一问题，我们构建了ITHV（图文幻觉可验证性数据集），包含2,728个视觉落地实例，用以区分人类容易察觉的“明显幻觉”和人类难以识别的“隐蔽幻觉”。随后，我们提出DAPO-V，这是DAPO的扩展方法，它在可验证性感知风险预算的约束下最大化正确性。具体而言，DAPO-V将可验证性感知奖励与自适应双重控制相结合：对于人类验证准确率较低的问题，模型给出的错误回答会被施加更大的惩罚；自适应乘数则根据风险预算的违规情况进一步调整惩罚强度。在三个多模态大语言模型基线（摘要原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该研究构建了区分“明显幻觉”与“隐蔽幻觉”的ITHV数据集，并提出DAPO-V方法，通过可验证性感知奖励与自适应惩罚机制，在风险预算约束下缓解多模态大语言模型强化学习中难以验证的幻觉问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ITHV, a dataset distinguishing obvious from elusive hallucinations, and proposes DAPO-V, which mitigates hard-to-verify hallucinations in MLLM reinforcement learning by combining verifiability-aware rewards with adaptive penalties under a risk budget.
